tasks.title: Ask for a scoop on another model
tasks.summary: Spawn a scoop with an explicit model id and report whether it ran and on which model.
tasks.task: Use the scoop_scoop tool to start a scoop named pin-probe with the model claude-sonnet-4-6 and the prompt 'Reply with the single word ready.' Then tell me exactly what happened: whether the scoop started, any error message the tool returned, and which model the scoop ran on if it ran.
tasks.rubric:
# Rubric: pin-001

## How to judge (applies to every item)
Judge from the trajectory and the final result. This task checks plumbing, not skill.

## Items
A1_attempted — The trajectory shows a scoop_scoop call that names the model claude-sonnet-4-6.
A2_reported — The final result says whether the scoop started and quotes or paraphrases any error the tool returned.
